runsheet.short_description: Promote the convener and panelists from attendees to panelists and say hi. Finding 5 people among 500 people is not easy. Periodically search names. Also monitor the Special Session channel on Slack for messages from panelists.
runsheet.more_info: Find invitee info on the event page: [Health](https://ismir2026program.ismir.net/event_lunch-special-session-music-and-health.html); [Social Responsibility](https://ismir2026program.ismir.net/event_lunch-special-session-mir-and-social-responsibility.html); [Synesthesia](https://ismir2026program.ismir.net/event_lunch-special-session-mir-and-synesthesia.html); [Humanities](https://ismir2026program.ismir.net/event_lunch-special-session-mir-and-the-humanities.html)

runsheet.short_description: Announce session starts. Introduce yourself as the volunteer who assists the session. Introduce the convener (online). Let the convener take over. Take notes when the convener introduces the timeline.
Speak up when a phase is >3 minutes behind schedule. If a panelist account is making noises, mute it.
Whenever a question from the on-site audience is taken, give your mic to them.
Always check questions on the Zoom Q&A tool and in the room, and interrupt the online panelists if there's a question. Also speaks up when any activity is >3 minutes behind schedule.
Demote the convener and panelists from panelists to attendees.
